WiFi Mesh Developer

Apply Now

Tata Elxsi works with leading OEMs and suppliers in the automotive & transportation industries for R&D, Design and Product Engineering Services, right from architecture to launch and beyond. We bring together technologies that accelerate development & testing of connected autonomous and electric cars & off-highway vehicles 

We are seeking a skilled WiFi Mesh Developer with 5+ years of experience in broadband, networking, and connected-home technologies. The ideal candidate should have expertise in Mesh WiFi solutions, EasyMesh, Embedded Linux, networking protocols, and gateway/router development.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and enhance Mesh WiFi features for residential and enterprise wireless products.
  • Design and implement IEEE 1905.1 and Wi-Fi EasyMesh functionalities.
  • Work on Access Point steering, Client steering, Band steering, and Load balancing.
  • Develop and optimize roaming solutions to improve user experience.
  • Integrate Mesh functionalities with broadband gateways, routers, and extenders.
  • Analyze and resolve performance, connectivity, and interoperability issues.
  • Collaborate with platform, QA, and customer engineering teams.
  • Participate in debugging, root cause analysis, and feature development.

Mandatory Skills:

  • 5+ years of experience in Networking or Embedded Linux Development
  • Strong experience in WiFi Mesh Development
  • Hands-on experience with: 
  • Wi-Fi EasyMesh (Multi-AP)
  • IEEE 1905.1
  • Wi-Fi 5 (802.11ac) / Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax)
  • AP Steering
  • Client Steering
  • Band Steering
  • Load Balancing
  • Fast Roaming (802.11k/v/r)
  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP Networking
  • Experience with Embedded Linux platforms
  • Proficiency in C/C++ programming
  • Experience in debugging Mesh and wireless issues using Wireshark and Linux tools
  • Knowledge of Routing, Switching, DHCP, DNS, NAT, and Firewall

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience in RDK-B
  • OpenWRT/PrplOS/PrplWRT development
  • Broadband Gateway/CPE Development
  • TR-069, TR-181, USP (TR-369)
  • DOCSIS, GPON, xPON
  • Qualcomm, Broadcom, MediaTek, or MaxLinear WiFi chipsets
  • Shell/Python scripting
